name: Appartment Kalkus
beschreibung: Appartment Kalkus is operated as a traditional Tyrolean guesthouse and inn. The establishment offers multiple guest rooms along with a restaurant area serving regional culinary specialities. Accommodations are traditionally decorated, highlighting genuine alpine hospitality. Guests can book half board to savour hearty Tyrolean flavours. Situated in the heart of Tyrol, the guesthouse serves as an inviting base for outings into the surrounding alpine world.
